name: Tome of the Viper
description: Ancient serpent-lore bound in scaled leather. Teaches the Viper Stance to an eligible warrior — poison ticks deal +2 damage when attacking with a poison weapon.

name: Tome of the Ghost
description: A whisper-thin manuscript that seems to fade from sight. Teaches the Ghost Stance — monster hit chance reduced by 15%.

name: Tome of the Inquisitor
description: Heavy tome clasped in iron. Teaches the Inquisitor Stance — +40% resistance to all on-hit status effects.

name: Tome of the Holy
description: Pages gleaming with sanctified light. Teaches the Holy Stance — +25% damage dealt to undead monsters.

name: Tome of the Heartseeker
description: A tattered hunter's log of vital strikes. Teaches the Heartseeker Stance — +10% critical hit chance on attacks.

name: Tome of Vengeance
description: Pages still crackling with arcane wrath. Teaches the Vengeance Stance — +50% damage on damage-dealing spells.

name: Tome of SpellSurge
description: A scholar's treatise on accelerated casting. Teaches the SpellSurge Stance — -30% cooldown on all spells.

name: Tome of Retribution
description: A knightly codex bound in mirrored steel. Teaches the Retribution Stance — reflects 25% of incoming damage back onto the attacker.

name: Tome of Curatio
description: A healer's bestiary of restorative incantations. Teaches the Curatio Stance — cure and heal spells restore +6 HP; Regeneration heals +3 HP per tick.

name: Tome of the Slayer
description: A blood-spattered war-chant carved into stone. Teaches the Slayer Stance — enters a state of roaring fury, boosting all damage dealt by 80%.

name: Tome of the Talon
description: A predator's meditation on striking twice. Teaches the Talon Stance — strike twice with every attack.

name: Tome of Overclock
description: A frantic mechanist's journal. Teaches the Overclock Stance — doubles attack speed at the cost of stamina and focus.

name: Tome of Bloodgrudge
description: A vengeful ledger of wounds repaid. Teaches the Bloodgrudge Stance — steal 10 HP from enemies on successful hits.
